def style_lines(lines: List[Dict[str, Any]], columns: int,
    pre_processed_text: str='', start_line: str=' ' * 4, end_line: str=' ' * 4
    ) ->str:
    result = pre_processed_text
    for line in lines:
        words = line.get('words', [])
        line_text = ''
        for word in words:
            value = word.get('value', '')
            style_opts = word.get('style', {})
            if style_opts:
                value = click.style(value, **style_opts)
            line_text += value
        result += line_text
    return result

def format_vulnerability(vulnerability: Any, full_mode: bool, only_text:
    bool=False, columns: int=get_terminal_size().columns) ->str:
    indent = ' ' * 3
    kwargs = {'indent': indent, 'sub_indent': indent, 'columns': columns,
              'start_line_decorator': '', 'end_line_decorator': ''}

    pkg = vulnerability.pkg
    req = pkg.requirements[0] if pkg.requirements else None
    is_pinned = is_pinned_requirement(req) if req else True

    lines = []

    if is_pinned:
        title = f'-> Vulnerability found in {pkg.name} version {pkg.version}'
    else:
        spec_str = str(req.specifier) if req and req.specifier else ''
        req_str = f'{pkg.name}{spec_str}'
        title = f'-> Vulnerability may be present given that your {pkg.name} install specifier is\n{indent}{req_str}'

    title_styled = click.style(title, fg=RED, bold=True)
    lines.append(format_long_text(title_styled, **kwargs))

    vuln_id_line = f'Vulnerability ID: {vulnerability.vulnerability_id}'
    lines.append(format_long_text(vuln_id_line, **kwargs))

    if vulnerability.ignored:
        ignored_line = 'This vulnerability is being ignored.'
        expires = vulnerability.ignored_expires
        if expires:
            expires_str = expires.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')
            ignored_line = f'This vulnerability is being ignored until {expires_str}. See your configurations.'
        lines.append(format_long_text(ignored_line, **kwargs))

        reason = vulnerability.ignored_reason
        if reason:
            lines.append(format_long_text(f'Reason: {reason}', **kwargs))

        more_info = f'For more information about this vulnerability, visit\n{indent}{vulnerability.more_info_url}'
        if columns >= 120:
            more_info = f'For more information about this vulnerability, visit {vulnerability.more_info_url}'
        lines.append(format_long_text(more_info, **kwargs) + '\n')
    else:
        affected_spec = f'Affected spec: {vulnerability.vulnerable_spec}'
        lines.append(format_long_text(affected_spec, **kwargs))

        advisory = f'ADVISORY: {vulnerability.advisory if vulnerability.advisory else ""}'
        lines.append(format_long_text(advisory, **kwargs))

        secure_versions = pkg.secure_versions if pkg.secure_versions else []
        if secure_versions:
            fixed_versions = ', '.join(str(v) for v in secure_versions)
            fixed_line = f'Fixed versions: {fixed_versions}'
        else:
            fixed_line = 'Fixed versions: No known fix'
        lines.append(format_long_text(fixed_line, **kwargs))

        cve = vulnerability.CVE
        if cve and (cve.cvssv3 or cve.cvssv2):
            severity_lines = []
            if cve.cvssv3:
                v3 = cve.cvssv3
                severity = v3.get('base_severity', '').upper()
                base_score = v3.get('base_score', '')
                impact_score = v3.get('impact_score', '')
                vector = v3.get('vector_string', '')
                sev_msg = f'{vulnerability.advisory} is {severity} SEVERITY => CVSS v3, BASE SCORE {base_score}, IMPACT SCORE {impact_score}, VECTOR STRING {vector}'
                severity_lines.append(format_long_text(sev_msg, **kwargs))
            if cve.cvssv2:
                v2 = cve.cvssv2
                base_score = v2.get('base_score', '')
                impact_score = v2.get('impact_score', '')
                vector = v2.get('vector_string', '')
                v2_msg = f'CVSS v2, BASE SCORE {base_score}, IMPACT SCORE {impact_score}, VECTOR STRING {vector}'
                severity_lines.append(format_long_text(v2_msg, **kwargs))
            lines.extend(severity_lines)

        if not is_pinned:
            range_info_lines = [
                'This vulnerability is present in your install specifier range.',
                get_specifier_range_info(style=False),
            ]
            for ri in range_info_lines:
                lines.append(format_long_text(ri, **kwargs))

        more_info = f'For more information about this vulnerability, visit\n{indent}{vulnerability.more_info_url}'
        lines.append(format_long_text(more_info, **kwargs))

        ignore_msg = f'To ignore this vulnerability, use PyUp vulnerability id {vulnerability.vulnerability_id} in\n{indent}safety\u2019s ignore command-line argument or add the ignore to your safety\n{indent}policy file.'
        lines.append(format_long_text(ignore_msg, **kwargs) + '\n')

    result = '\n'.join(lines)
    if only_text:
        result = click.unstyle(result)
    return result

def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    if not text or text == '\n':
        width = columns
        return start_line_decorator + ' ' * (width - len(start_line_decorator) - len(end_line_decorator)) + end_line_decorator

    raw_text = click.unstyle(text)
    wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
        width=columns - len(start_line_decorator) - len(end_line_decorator),
        initial_indent=indent,
        subsequent_indent=sub_indent if sub_indent else indent,
        break_long_words=False,
        break_on_hyphens=False,
    )

    wrapped_lines = wrapper.wrap(raw_text)

    if not wrapped_lines:
        wrapped_lines = ['']

    if max_lines:
        wrapped_lines = wrapped_lines[:max_lines]

    styled_lines = []
    if color or styling:
        for line in wrapped_lines:
            if color:
                styled_line = click.style(line, fg=color)
            else:
                styled_line = line
            styled_lines.append(styled_line)
    else:
        styled_lines = wrapped_lines

    result_lines = []
    for line in styled_lines:
        result_lines.append(start_line_decorator + line + end_line_decorator)

    return '\n'.join(result_lines)

        break_on_hyphens=False,

    styled_lines = []
